title: Tuesday Night Trivia
subtitle: Two Rounds · Immediate Reveal · Secret Theme
theme: The letters 'OO' or the 'Spooky OO' sound (/uː/ as in boo, moon, or Louis)
formalTheme: Spooky 'OO's — Every question or answer features either the letters 'OO' (regardless of pronunciation!) or the phonetic 'oo' sound (/uː/ as in boo, Louis, or Jiu-Jitsu)!
rules: Round 1 has a SECRET THEME. Submit your guess in the Theme Box on your phone anytime during Round 1 for bonus points!
Each round starts with 6 Hodgepodge questions, followed by two 2-question Special Categories, and a 4-question Confidence Set (where you assign 8, 6, 4, and 2 points across the 4 categories).
Round 2 finishes with a Final Jeopardy lock-in wager question.
Always check the Answer Type label so you submit the exact target.

questions.text: For a generation of girls in the 2000s, peak PC gaming was sitting at the family computer, frantically clicking through the Her Interactive point-and-click mystery series. One of the greatest pieces of lore in those games was an eccentric, alien-obsessed character who never actually appeared on screen for the first 29 installments, but constantly left behind a chaotic trail of half-finished jobs, weird sticky notes, and UFO doodles for our teenage sleuth to find.
questions.questionPrompt: Who is the titular teenage sleuth of this PC game series?
